answer: Keep the agent orchard honest with correlation-doubling marble bonds. Each identity locks a small marble bond before trading. Every epoch a gale of public randomness sweeps the ledger: auditors cluster identities by behavioral correlation — shared timing, counterparties, message rhythms. In a cluster of k correlated identities, each member's bond rises to base x 2^(k-1). One honest agent pays base; N lockstep clones owe N x base x 2^(N-1) — exponential, not linear, and unshareable, since faking distinct behavior costs real work per clone. No delay, puzzle, or flat fee to amortize.
